map.联轴器选型：基于额定扭矩、工况系数（冲击/起动）与安全系数，按计算扭矩从标准系列: Coupling selection: based on rated torque, service factor (shock/start) and safety factor, pick a coupling from the standard series by calculated torque, and check speed and load-characteristic match, for shaft-connection design.
map.💡 选型扭矩=Tn×K1×K2×负载系数；按选型扭矩从标准系列中选取: Formula: selection torque=Tn times K1 times K2 times load factor; pick from the standard series by selection torque.

map.📚 深度解析：联轴器选型计算（综合系数与选型扭矩）: In-depth: Coupling selection calculation (combined factor and selection torque)
map.传动选型：由额定扭矩与工况系数确定联轴器选型扭矩: Transmission selection: determine coupling selection torque from rated torque and service factor.
map.型式判断：按扭矩区间选弹性柱销、齿式、膜片或万向联轴器: Type judgment: by torque range pick pin/bush, gear, diaphragm or universal coupling.
map.转速校核：按转速判断是否需动平衡与高精度型式: Speed check: by speed judge whether dynamic balancing and high-precision type are needed.
map.算法：选型扭矩 = 额定扭矩 T × 工况系数 K₁ × 安全系数 K₂ × 负: Algorithm: selection torque = rated torque T times service factor K1 times safety factor K2 times load-characteristic factor; combined factor = K1 times K2 times load factor; recommended type: <50 N m pin/bush or jaw, <2000 N m pinned-bush or gear, <50000 N m gear or diaphragm, else large gear or universal. Speed hints: >3000 rpm high speed, diaphragm or high-precision gear advised; >1500 rpm medium-high speed, mind dynamic balancing. Transmitted power P = rated torque T times speed n / 9550 (kW), e.g. 200 N m, 1450 rpm -> 30.37 kW.
map.例：T=200N·m、K₁=1.5、K₂=1.3、n=1450rpm、负载系数: Example: T=200 N m, K1=1.5, K2=1.3, n=1450 rpm, load factor 1.5 -> selection torque 585.0 N m, combined factor 2.93, transmitted power 30.37 kW, recommend pinned-bush / gear coupling, moderate torque with strong gear capacity. If T=800 N m, K1=2.0, K2=1.5, n=960 rpm, load factor 2.0 -> selection torque 4800.0 N m, combined factor 6.00, transmitted power 80.42 kW, up to gear / diaphragm coupling. If torque drops to 20 N m and factor 1.0 -> selection torque 20.0 N m, power 3.04 kW, recommend pin/bush or jaw, compensating eccentricity and damping.
map.K₁、K₂ 和负载特性系数会不会重复放大？: Do K1, K2 and load factor triple-multiply and over-amplify?
map.三者相乘确实会显著放大选型扭矩。K₁ 通常反映原动机与工作机的工况（如电机带冲击: Multiplying all three does significantly amplify the selection torque. K1 usually reflects the prime mover and machine condition (e.g. motor with shock load 1.5 to 2.0), K2 is the design safety margin, load factor reflects uniform/moderate/shock. Suggest taking the service factor from the manual first, then only one 1.1 to 1.3 design margin, to avoid triple stacking and oversizing.
map.传递功率怎么算？和选型扭矩什么关系？: How is transmitted power computed and its relation to selection torque?
map.传递功率按实际传递的额定扭矩算：P = 额定扭矩 T × 转速 n ÷ 9550: Transmitted power is by the actual rated torque: P = rated torque T times speed n / 9550 (kW), e.g. 200 N m, 1450 rpm -> 30.37 kW. Selection torque = T times K1 times K2 times load factor, the design value with condition and safety margin; to assess by design power, convert: 585 times 1450 / 9550 = 88.82 kW.
